name: Factory
description: Factory is an agent-native software development platform built around 'Droids' — autonomous coding agents that take a spec, plan changes across a repo, run tests, and open PRs. Series B in September 2025 ($50M) and a reported Series C in 2026 (~$1.5B valuation) positioned it as a leading enterprise SWE-agent vendor.
pricingDetails: Pay-as-you-go credits ($10 minimum). Team and Enterprise plans quote-based.
